messages:
Nina: Heads-up: partners asked for a short 'onboarding playbook' that includes a reference-arch, terraform module examples, and a one-page marketplace checklist. Need owner for AWS example.

Dev: I can take AWS. Idea: create `marketplace-iac/aws-playbook` with 3 small example tfvars (demo, ha, private). Each example should be runnable with `make deploy-demo` and `make destroy-demo`.

Marco: Sounds good. Add a security section: least-priv IAM, KMS for S3, VPC endpoints, and S3 lifecycle rules for logs. Also include an explicit note for Private deployments about HSM/KMS placement.

Nina: Timeline: partner kickoff 05/05. Can we have an AWS MVP by 04/22? Minimal deliverables: module + README + a CI smoke script.

Dev: Yep. Deliver plan: module + README by 04/15, CI smoke script against sandbox by 04/20. I'll include variables for instance_type, asg_min, asg_max, ami_id, spot_enabled.

Marco: For the README template: 1) short arch paragraph, 2) quick deploy (init/apply), 3) test steps (curl /health and a small inference POST), 4) teardown, 5) known limitations (not for prod). I'll draft it.

RepoBot: Created issue: redwood-inference/marketplace-iac#72 - onboarding-playbook (https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-iac/issues/72)

Compliance: Reminder: include the telemetry blurb. Draft: "This module may log anonymized request metrics to S3 for diagnostics. Customers must enable KMS; partners should disclose any PII processing."

Nina: Perfect. Action items: @Dev -> AWS module + CI script (PR draft by 04/15). @Marco -> README template + checklist (04/12). @Nina -> create GH issue and schedule 30m review. We'll sync next Tue. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
